note: Big Horn County, MT has no county zoning per its 2014 growth policy (subdivision, floodplain and sanitation rules only). Its largest city, Hardin, publishes its zoning map only as a 2019 static PDF (8-2019-Zoning.pdf); no ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning polygons found for the county or Hardin. The Frontier Institute compiled zoning layer on ArcGIS Online has no Hardin features. Commercial parcel datasets with zoning fields exist (uslandgrid, Regrid) but are not official, so not used.
